Memos have two layers of content-derived metadata:

| Layer | Fields | Storage | When computed |
|-------|--------|---------|---------------|
| **Persisted payload** | `tags`, `property.*` | `memo.payload` JSON column | On content write |
| **Response-only** | `snippet` | Not stored | On every API read/conversion |

	// ...

		Tags:     []string{},
		Mentions: []string{},
		Property: &storepb.MemoPayload_Property{},
